title: [Bug]  Azure gpt-5-chat incorrectly classified as reasoning model
author: mindful-time

comments.author: yashwantbezawada
comments.body:
Fixed in PR #9037!

The regex pattern has been updated to use exact matching with the `$` anchor, preventing `gpt-5-chat` from being incorrectly classified as a reasoning model.

**Changes:**
- Added `$` end anchor to prevent prefix matching
- Added support for `gpt-5-pro` as a valid reasoning model variant
- Explicit date suffix support for o-series models
- Added test cases to verify `gpt-5-chat` does NOT match and `gpt-5-pro` DOES match

Users can now use `gpt-5-chat` with standard conversational parameters without triggering the inappropriate reasoning model validation.
